cand.title: Hospital Medicine CME Conference Punta Cana 2027

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Özlem Carlson, MBA, COO: manages most business aspects and is explicitly copied on hotel-reservation exceptions; strongest commercially relevant organizer contact. Steve Burgess, MD, MBA: founder and educational lead, also listed on the 2027 faculty; relevant executive relationship sponsor. Neither is publicly established as the hotel-contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Verified upcoming in-person Hospital Medicine Update, November 3–6, 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. Dates appear in the organizer’s event heading, detailed agenda and official brochure; these are activity dates, not article dates. Within the requested November 2026–May 2028 horizon. No subsequent Punta Cana edition was established by the reviewed sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: an all-inclusive beach resort is a credible format fit because the programme combines morning classroom learning with free afternoons and leisure/family amenities. Wyndham Alltra’s published 620 rooms, three meeting venues, 380 m² and maximum 300 conference guests suggest potential for a guestroom-led future edition, conditional on actual classroom layout, attendance, AV, faculty needs and commercial terms. Resort suitability is stronger than a city-hotel thesis for this specific format, but no room requirement or attendance is published and capacity alone does not prove fit.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 organizer page explicitly names “Conference Hotel: Iberostar Bávaro in Punta Cana”; conference room remains TBD. Accommodation choices are Iberostar Selection Bávaro Suites, Iberostar Waves Punta Cana and JOIA Bávaro by Iberostar. The brochure calls these recommended accommodations, but the stronger event-page conference-hotel designation establishes an announced host, not merely a generic preferred-hotel list. Executed contract, exclusivity and block allocation are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented same-organizer Punta Cana precedent: Outpatient Medicine Update, May 13–16, 2026, Iberostar Selection Bávaro Suites; the organizer’s May 2026 accommodation page names Iberostar Bávaro and rooms Samana and Saona. This is a related programme, not a verified prior Hospital Medicine Punta Cana edition. The 2027 Hospital Medicine event again names Iberostar Bávaro. Evidence supports repeat destination/incumbent use, not annual Hospital Medicine recurrence or a destination-rotation policy.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Attendees book lodging separately from CME registration through the incumbent hotel pathway. The 2027 page publishes negotiated Iberostar rates, a four-night minimum and group-rate extensions up to three days before/after the event. It says “Reservations Link Coming Soon” while also exposing an Iberostar group-booking link; the same group identifier appears on the historical May 2026 page, so its applicability to November 2027 is unverified. Instructions direct additional-night requests to groupreservations.dr@iberostar.com, copying ozlem@cmevacations.com. This is attendee reservation access, not evidence of open hotel procurement. No open RFP or external accommodation buyer was established.
findings.organizationStructure: CME Vacations, LLC is the organizer and destination-CME business founded by Dr. Steve Burgess, not presented as a membership association. Its own staff include a COO and office administrator. The event lists Partners for Advancing Clinical Education as an education/accreditation collaborator; that does not establish hotel-buying authority. Iberostar is the announced venue/lodging incumbent. No separate appointed PCO, DMC or accommodation agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Iberostar already combines the announced meeting venue with three published lodging tiers, including family-friendly and adults-only choices, plus negotiated group rates. That makes displacement commercially difficult. The historical page’s warning that discounted rooms tend to sell out is not proof of an actual sellout or overflow. The event page also contains “Sale Sold out” storefront text; this is not evidence of hotel occupancy, block exhaustion or cancellation. No confirmed overflow, competitor capacity shortfall or Wyndham allocation was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Özlem Carlson at the publicly listed ozlem@cmevacations.com, acknowledging the announced Iberostar host and asking whether a later Punta Cana cycle is uncontracted and when proposals are reviewed. Request historic in-person attendance, actual room pickup/peak rooms, classroom and breakout requirements, family mix, rate inclusions and decision/signature authority. Offer a concise all-inclusive classroom-plus-guestroom proposal using Wyndham’s published capacities, conditional on fit. Seek founder Steve Burgess as executive sponsor through the public info@cmevacations.com channel; this is not a verified personal email. Pursue 2027 overflow only if the organizer confirms an unmet need and acceptable off-site access/transport arrangements.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected November 2027 edition, the host is announced elsewhere; treat primary venue sourcing as committed elsewhere, not open. Attendee booking-link readiness and remaining block inventory are unconfirmed. No sourced route to Wyndham overflow or satellite meetings exists. Registration availability also needs direct confirmation because storefront “Sold out” text conflicts with forward-looking booking instructions; it does not invalidate the published activity dates.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeat same-organizer destination use makes a future competitive pitch commercially reasonable, but does not verify a later edition, a recurring annual cycle, incumbent expiry or willingness to move. Develop an organizer relationship for the next uncontracted Punta Cana cycle rather than forecast November 2027 room nights. No future-cycle dates or sourcing window should be published until confirmed.
